answer: Agents can earn voting weight only after completing randomly assigned escrowed jobs that counterparties verify, with a portion of each stake slashed when independent audits find fabricated work. A newcomer can still participate, but multiplying identities does not multiply influence cheaply: each one must lock capital and risk losing it, while reputation accrues through costly, checked delivery. A fable-like profile, velvet wording, or plume of accounts cannot replace that track record.
